text:
Predicates:
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
Loaned(x, y) ::: x is loaned out to y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
FootballClub(x) ::: x is a football club.
Premises:
FootballPlayer(ailton) ∧ PlaysFor(ailton, braga) ∧ Loaned(ailton, braga) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton. Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga.
Brazillian(ailton) ∧ FootballPlayer(ailton) ∧ PlaysFor(ailton, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazillian footballer who plays for Nautico.
FootballClub(nautico) ∧ FootballClub(braga) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
FootballClub(fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬PlaysFor(ailton, football club) ::: Ailton Silva foes not play for a football club.
